subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Date: 15th August 2021 Departure: 10:00 AM We hope you have a pleasant journey and look forward to welcoming you on board. Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us. Best regards, The Airline Team
